name: portal-operator
summary: Deploys the separate Technology Preview Automation Portal Operator path.

lifecycle.idempotency: Captures ownership before reconciling the operator, subscription, portal custom resource, and owned AAP records.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before changing shared operator resources when catalog, ownership, or AAP prerequisites fail.

readiness: The owned operator subscription and portal custom resource are ready.

security.secret_storage: Owned AAP OAuth credentials are retained in protected addon state and are not written to the contract.
security.network_trust: Catalog and AAP endpoints follow configured cluster trust controls.
security.external_actions: The operator path does not modify the Helm Portal release.
